subject: Film & Cinema
title: The Courtroom Drama
description: A 60-second lesson on The Courtroom Drama.

hook.text: 12 Angry Men takes place in one room, and it's one of the most gripping films ever made.

buildup.text: Courtroom dramas turn legal arguments into emotional battlegrounds for justice.

discovery.text: The genre works because trials are naturally dramatic — someone's fate hangs in the balance.

twist.text: Real courtrooms are mostly boring. Film compresses weeks of procedure into minutes.

climax.text: From To Kill a Mockingbird to A Few Good Men, the genre demands powerful performances.

punchline.text: The best drama needs only a room and a verdict.

quiz.question: Why do courtroom dramas work so well as films?
options: Trials are naturally dramatic with high stakes
